reason: The staging lineage applied the supplies commerce migration as 0111 before this release renumbered it to 0112. That journal row is immutable, so production's 0111_mvgs_rules_version.sql can never apply on that host. 0113 delivers the identical column, comment, backfill and index instead, and is a verified no-op wherever 0111_mvgs_rules_version.sql is already applied.
